subject: Re: IEG status: decision - tiered recommendation adopted
body:
All,

Decision for the July 13 memo: we adopt the tiered recommendation as Tereza framed it. FSR becomes the default noise-robust training option on the platform (most of the benefit, modest overhead), and IEG is the heavy-duty mode for label sources we know are severely noisy - the 80% uniform-noise CIFAR100 result is the evidence that it holds up where FSR fades. RandAugment is the standard augmentation in both modes.

Bilal's cost/accuracy frontier chart goes in as the decision graphic; the 2x meta-step cost for IEG needs to be stated plainly so nobody turns it on by default.

Bruno - the harness Chiara and Emeka built deserves its own paragraph in the memo. Controlled noise injection with seed management is what made these claims defensible, and I want leadership to see where the seven weeks went.

Q3 follow-on is a pilot with one real labeling-pipeline consumer; I'll bring it to the OKR check-in.

Dmitri
